capacity_notes: A68 annual values are not current turbine counts. Each year uses its own capacity, never latest capacity for historical output. Missing capacity gives null load factor. Sweden has no current-year country A68, so its last annual country A68 is held for current-year dates only (see capacity_latest.SE); this can slightly overstate the load factor if capacity grew. Bidding-zone A68 is a separate scope and is not summed to replace it.

DK wind cross-check, overlapping days: 5-minute vs official settlement 2026-08-22..2026-11-10 n=80, mean 4.05% (median 3.62%, max abs 35.26%)

A CET day is kept when at least 98% of expected 15-minute intervals are present; missing intervals are omitted from the daily mean, not filled. Isolated gaps of one calendar day (both neighbours present) are then linearly interpolated so the 30-day average is not blanked; longer gaps stay null.

SE wind 2026-11-08 uses the 95 of 96 published ENTSO-E A75 intervals (15:45–16:00 UTC missing), above the 98% bar, and is not interpolated. NO wind 2026-10-26 is short of the 98% bar (4 of 96 onshore intervals missing, 14:00–14:45 UTC) and is linearly interpolated from 25 and 27 Oct.
